blocks.text:
Begin your day with a morning guided tour of the iconic Machu Picchu, one of the Seven Wonders of the World. Explore the ancient Incan citadel, discovering its impressive temples, plazas, and terraces. Your knowledgeable guide will share fascinating insights into the history, culture, and significance of this UNESCO World Heritage site as you wander through the mystical ruins and take in the breathtaking views of the surrounding mountains. Lunch is included.

After your memorable visit, enjoy a scenic train journey back to Cusco in the afternoon. As you travel through the stunning Andean landscape, take in the beautiful vistas of valleys, rivers, and mountains that make this region so unique. Upon arriving in Cusco, you’ll have the rest of the evening free to explore this vibrant city at your own pace.
